statement: The hash-pinned external three-component N-001 working branch is audited and shown not to close variationally under the frozen real torus pairing: its scalar energy nonlinearities are factor-two inconsistent with the residual, and its Class-II energy uses cKK whereas residual uses cJK. Separately, the manifest defines a proposed all-coupling reference functional with lambda/4 rho^2 + gamma/6 rho^3 and a symmetric cJJ/cJK/cKK J-K quadratic form. Independent energy finite differences plus Torch-autodiff gradient and centred-gradient Hessian checks close DF_ref[Psi](v)=<R_ref[Psi],v>_R, DR_ref[Psi]v=H_ref[Psi]v, and real Hessian symmetry on zero, homogeneous, random, q0-shell, and Class-II-active N=4 fields.
